name: spec-gate
description: spec-gate, served from its own repository

plugins.name: spec-gate
plugins.description: Workflow skills that guard changes with tests: fix-bug reproduces a bug as a failing test before the fix, spec-to-tests turns a feature request into tests before the code, adopt-tests guards tests another skill wrote, verify-changes checks a change against them and the whole suite, and learn-project drafts the repository's testing knowledge.
